children: on Saturday reported a 65% jump in second-quarter profit to 10.80 billion rupees ($114 million), but said the figure did not reflect the impact of a Supreme Court ruling this week that set aside its 2020 write-off of 84 billion rupees ($884 million) of additional tier-1 bonds.
